cards_board_path_order_idx.name: cards_board_path_order_idx
cards_board_path_order_idx.where: "cards"."path_order" is not null and "cards"."deleted_at" is null

cards_size_chk.name: cards_size_chk
cards_size_chk.value: ("cards"."width" is null and "cards"."height" is null) or ("cards"."width" between 140 and 640 and "cards"."height" between 90 and 560)

challenge_attempts_verdict_chk.name: challenge_attempts_verdict_chk
challenge_attempts_verdict_chk.value: ("challenge_attempts"."verdict" is null) = ("challenge_attempts"."graded_by" = 'pending') and ("challenge_attempts"."verdict" is null or "challenge_attempts"."verdict" in ('correct', 'partial', 'incorrect'))

question_bank_objective_chk.name: question_bank_objective_chk
question_bank_objective_chk.value: ("question_bank"."type" = 'objective') = ("question_bank"."correct_key" is not null and "question_bank"."alternatives" is not null)

referrals_email_channel.name: referrals_email_channel
referrals_email_channel.value: "referrals"."channel" <> 'email' or ("referrals"."invited_email_hash" is not null and "referrals"."invited_email_masked" is not null)

store_waitlist_role.name: store_waitlist_role
store_waitlist_role.value: ("store_waitlist"."wants_sell" and "store_waitlist"."seller_role" in ('teacher', 'student_resident', 'physician')) or (not "store_waitlist"."wants_sell" and "store_waitlist"."seller_role" is null)
